Content:
Entry orchestrator CreatureMeshGenerator (Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Generation/CreatureMeshGenerator.cs, ns ProceduralCreature.Generation) is static and explicitly staged/singly-owned (CC-091). Entry points: Generate(definition, out MeshTopologyReport, diagnostics, meshResolver) -> GenerateData then Assemble; GenerateData(definition, diagnostics) -> GeneratedCreatureData (pure data, no Unity Mesh).

STAGES inside GenerateData: 1 ValidateAndResolve (DefinitionValidator.Validate throws DomainException if invalid, marks GenerationStage.Validation, then ResolvedCreatureSnapshot.Resolve) -> 2 GenerateImplicitField (SdfProgramBuilder.CompilePortable then DensityGrid.SamplePortable) -> 3 ExtractMesh (MarchingCubesExtractor.Extract(grid); takes ownership of grid, disposes in finally) -> 4 ValidateMesh (MeshTopologyValidator.Validate) -> 5 BakeAppearance (SdfProgramBuilder.CompileIndividualPartsPortable + CompilePortableBodyField then AppearanceBaker.Bake). Assemble is the Unity-Mesh boundary: builds item 0 via data.MeshResult.ToUnityMesh(), mesh.SetColors, then AppendMeshAssetItems for mesh-geometry parts ascending by SourcePartId, mirroring via MirrorUtility.ReflectTransformAcrossX.

GeneratedCreature = deterministic ordered List<GeometryItem>. Constants ImplicitSurfaceSourceId="" (item 0) and MirrorSuffix="_mirror". MainMesh = Geometry[0].Mesh. GeometryItem: SourcePartId, GeometryType, Mesh, SourceMesh, RestPlacement (Matrix4x4), MaterialRegions, RigBinding. Item 0 = implicit combined surface (Body + Shape/Limb parts). Items 1..n = mesh-asset/procedural parts in ascending SourcePartId. Supporting: MaterialRegion (StartIndex/IndexCount/MaterialKey), RigBindingMetadata (SourcePartId/ParentPartId/IsMirrored), GeneratedCreatureData (Definition, Snapshot, MeshResult, Colors, TopologyReport).

DRIVERS: CreatureGenerationScheduler queues GenerateData on Task.Run background thread -> sequenced CreatureGenerationResult (Succeeded/Exception/IsStale/Data/Diagnostics). CreatureRuntimePreview (MonoBehaviour) pulls completed results in Update() and calls Assemble on main thread then builds GameObject/MeshFilter/MeshRenderer/MeshCollider under children GeneratedGeometry_{i}. ScriptableObject resolvers: CreatureGenerationConfig, CreatureMeshPalette, CreatureMaterialPalette.

PORTABLE SDF COMPILER (Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Morphology/Sdf/): SmoothMinMath.SmoothMin(a,b,blendRadius) polynomial smooth min (blendRadius<=0 -> hard min). SdfProgram.cs: SdfOperationType enum (Empty, Sphere, Box, Capsule, Ellipsoid, Transform, Symmetry, SmoothUnion); struct SdfOperation (Type, A, B, Parameters float3, Matrix float4x4, DistanceScale, MinBound, MaxBound, Cullable); SdfProgram (sealed IDisposable) wraps NativeArray<SdfOperation> (Allocator.Persistent) + RootIndex + InfluenceRadius + optional root PotentialMin/MaxBound; ResolvedPartProgram ties ResolvedPartSnapshot to its own SdfProgram. SdfProgramBuilder (read-only, never mutates DNA): CompilePortable, CompilePortableBodyField, CompileIndividualPartsPortable; throws DomainException on programmer error; callers validate first. DETERMINISTIC ID-ORDERED FOLD: parts ordered OrderBy(Id, StringComparer.Ordinal) folded into smooth-union chain ascending Id, independent of authoring order. Body composed first in authoritative spline order (each sample -> Sphere under Transform; adjacent samples smooth-union blend min(prevR,r)*BodySampleBlendFactor 0.5; consumes shared ResolvedBody). Shape parts -> AppendResolvedPrimitive maps ShapeType to SDF op; limb parts -> CompileLimbChainPortable samples LimbMetaballSampler and emits sphere metaball chain with creature-space transform baked. Mesh-asset parts skipped (never in implicit field).

NON-UNIFORM SCALING approximation: distanceScale = min(|scale.x|,|scale.y|,|scale.z|) from localToCreature.lossyScale; Transform op multiplies evaluated primitive distance by DistanceScale. MIRROR: non-limb mirrored part wrapped in Symmetry op (min of op at point and at reflected (-x,y,z)); mirrored limb bakes mirrored chain in (hard union blend 0) because Symmetry op only wraps a primitive/transform subtree. Reflection across X=0 plane via MirrorUtility.ReflectTransformAcrossX. AABB/CULL: every Transform/union node stores world AABB + Cullable flag; ELLIPSOIDS (and subtrees containing one) are Cullable=false (approximate SDF can be smaller than AABB distance). InfluenceRadius = max smooth-blend radius + epsilon.

SIGN CONVENTION: negative-inside/positive-outside. Primitives return length-radius style. ActiveCellBuilder.ClassifyCaseIndex marks corner >=0 as on/outside (bit set). SdfProgramEvaluator non-finite contract (CC-064): +inf = outside/culled/absent; NaN always invalid; finite = field. Culling writes +inf for skipped ops. SmoothMin short-circuits +inf children before blending. Reference paths (EvaluateReference, scratch-buffer Evaluate) for parity tests. SdfSamplingJob : IJobParallelFor ([BurstCompile]) evaluates corner samples; root potential-bounds envelope check writes +inf outside.

MESH EXTRACTION (Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Morphology/Extraction/): DensityGrid fixed-resolution grid of SDF corner samples. SamplePortable(program,bounds,settings): cellSize=1/VoxelsPerUnit, cell counts from BoundsDefinition extents ceil(extent*2*VoxelsPerUnit), origin (-MaxX,-MaxY,-MaxZ), persistent NativeArray<float> (CX+1)(CY+1)(CZ+1), batched SdfSamplingJob with scratch budget PortableScratchValueBudget=8MB. EstimateGradient central finite differences with non-finite guards. ActiveCellBuilder/ActiveCell after dense sampling retains only mixed-sign cells (case 0 all-inside / 255 all-outside dropped); ActiveCellScanJob [BurstCompile] single-threaded IJob runs sequentially so output ordered by increasing global cell index (deterministic). 

WHY NO 256-ROW MC TABLE (CubeTopology.cs + CubeContourResolver.cs): a large externally-sourced lookup table can't be compile-verified here, so built from small hand-derived data. CubeTopology derives corners/edges/faces from one self-consistent bit-interleaved corner convention (bit0=x,bit1=y,bit2=z): 8 CornerOffsets, 12 EdgeCorners, 6 FaceCorners cyclic + matching FaceEdges. CubeContourResolver = 3 steps: (1) per-face segments - each of 6 faces counts crossed edges (0/2/4 only); 0 nothing, 2 one unambiguous segment, 4 (checkerboard/ambiguous) resolved via AsymptoticDecider; (2) loop tracing - every crossed cube edge borders exactly 2 faces and used by one segment from each -> degree exactly 2 -> disjoint closed loops (TraceLoops throws on degree !=2); (3) triangulation external in MarchingCubesExtractor, produces List<List<LoopVertex>> (LoopVertex = local EdgeIndex 0-11 + interpolated Position). NO HOLES across cubes: two cubes sharing a face compute ambiguous-face decision from the SAME 4 shared corner densities so always agree. InterpolateEdge clamps + guards non-finite/NaN/zero-denominator. AsymptoticDecider (Nielson & Hamann 1991): IsFaceAmbiguous pure sign test; DiagonalConnectsThroughMiddle tests sign of bilinear interpolant at saddle point saddleValue=(v00*v11-v01*v10)/D with degenerate-saddle fallback.

MarchingCubesExtractor: vertex welding keyed by grid edge identity (lowerCornerX,Y,Z,axis) in shared Dictionary<(int,int,int,int),int> so shared edge reuses vertex (connected mesh); zero-valued corners resolved by normalized endpoint value. EmitLoop fan-triangulates from vertex 0 (documented simplification, star-shaped loops at target resolution). Gradient winding correction: per-triangle using grid.EstimateGradient(centroid) - outward when dot(faceNormal,gradient)>=0 else swap 2nd/3rd. Degenerate zero-area skipped. Returns MeshExtractionResult + per-phase timings. MeshExtractionResult plain data (Positions, Triangles, counts MixedCellCount/GradientEvaluationCount/ContourResolutionCallCount, per-phase TimeSpans, Normals via ComputeAngleWeightedNormals - idempotent). ToUnityMesh is Unity boundary: UInt32 index format when >65535 verts, sets normals or RecalculateNormals, RecalculateBounds. MeshTopologyValidator.Validate counts undirected edge use; MeshTopologyReport IsWatertight when NonManifoldEdgeCount==0 && BoundaryEdgeCount==0.

APPEARANCE (Assets/Scripts/Runtime/Appearance/): AppearanceBaker.Bake(definition, mesh) -> per-vertex Color[]; resolves owning part appearance then modulates BaseColor by triplanar noise within BrightnessVariation=0.15. Consumes MeshExtractionResult plain data (ComputeAngleWeightedNormals if needed). BakePart bakes a mesh-asset part's OWN authored appearance (no nearest-part/Body). UseBurstResolve routes through AppearanceResolveBurst for bit-identical parity. PartAppearanceSampler.Resolver.Resolve(position) evaluates every part's individually-compiled program + Body program, picks SINGLE nearest finite surface (documented simplification - no seam blending). Body owns point when its finite distance <= nearest part distance -> Body vertical-gradient color. Resolver has AABB broad phase (EnableBroadPhase internal test hook): skip part whose squared AABB distance >= closest when every op Cullable. ResolvedAppearance: BaseColor/NoiseSeed/NoiseScale/MaterialKey. CC-064 +inf candidates skipped. AppearanceResolveBurst.ResolveAll fills distances matrix (+inf first), per-program job writes a column, AppearanceMergeJob resolves per-vertex; body gradient + triplanar noise stay managed (AnimationCurve/Gradient must render exactly). Perf note: managed per-vertex SDF resolve ~104.6ms of 107.5ms bake (~97%) on dino at 96^3; Burst removes that walk.

TriplanarNoise: 2D Perlin on 3 axis-aligned planes blended by |normal| magnitudes (normalized, 1/3 fallback), deterministic fixed seed offsets. BodyVerticalGradientSampler (CC-025/034, pure math): TryGetBodySample projects point onto Body polyline closest-point per-segment; body-length t 0=head/1=tail (head = end toward Forward); vertical sample = signed distance from spine centerline in WORLD up normalized by radius -> -1 bottom/+1 top; remap u=(v+1)*0.5 then blend=CurveAdapter.Evaluate(VerticalCurve,u); Color.Lerp(bottom,top,blend) with top/bottom = GradientAdapter.Evaluate(Top/BottomGradient,t); falls back gray. CC-028/074 per-part submaterial: MaterialRegion keys MaterialKey; CreatureMaterialPalette (ScriptableObject keyed Entry.Key/Material + DefaultMaterialKey) + MaterialResolver (Resolve explicit -> palette -> Material throws on unresolvable set key; ResolveDefault soft-fallback). Item 0 (implicit) deliberately gets no material region (vertex-color default).

RESOLVED MODEL (shared by validator, SDF, skeleton): ResolvedBody/ResolvedPolyline, ResolvedLimb (JointPositions/SegmentLengths/TotalLength/Thickness/RootSocket/TerminalSocket), LimbMetaballSampler - consumed by validator resolved-envelope stage, SdfProgramBuilder, SkeletonInferrer. Derived, never serialized (ADR-007). ResolvedCreatureSnapshot/ResolvedPartSnapshot in CreaturePartWorldTransformResolver (ns ProceduralCreature.Definition).

CLEAN SEAM: everything through GenerateData is pure runtime data (background-thread safe, independently testable). Assemble/ToUnityMesh is the ONLY place a UnityEngine.Mesh is constructed and runs on the main thread.
Title: CreatureCreator Generation Pipeline, SDF Compiler, Mesh Extraction, Appearance
